# Bab uji rumus Word {#sec-uji}

Rumus sebaris $\hat\theta = \bar{x}$ dan $\sigma^2 > 0$ menjadi persamaan Word.

$$
\begin{aligned}
p(\theta \mid y) &\propto p(y \mid \theta)\, p(\theta) \\
&= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} e^{-\theta^2/2}
\end{aligned}
$$

| Besaran | Rumus |
|---|---|
| rerata | $\frac{1}{n}\sum_i x_i$ |
| ragam | $\operatorname{Var}(X)$ |

Kode `x$y` dan biaya \$5 bukan rumus.
